# Patterns & Conventions

## Project-Specific Code Patterns

- **Long-running work goes through the queue.** API handlers enqueue and return immediately; see
  [architecture.md](architecture.md#tech-stack) for which work runs in the worker and how
  rendering is composited.
- **Provider choice is configuration.** TTS (edge-tts or Azure) and the Claude model are selected
  by config, not hard-coded, because edge-tts may stop working. The exception is the stock image
  source: it is fixed to Pixabay and not configurable.
- **Attribute adapted code.** Code adapted from MoneyPrinterTurbo keeps its MIT attribution in the
  file header.
- **The prompt is assembled from the Knowledge Base.** Prompt text and channel rules are app data
  that members can edit, not constants in code. See [content.md](content.md).

## Git Workflow

The default branch is `main`. Each feature follows the spec-driven flow:

1. Write `work/{feature}/user-spec.md`.
2. Implement it on a feature branch.
3. Open a PR into `main`.
4. Finalize: update docs and move the feature to `work/completed/`.

The GitHub Actions online pipeline (`.github/workflows/online-pipeline-*.yml`) is optional and
inactive until secrets are configured. See the README.

### Quality Gates

[ci-cd.yml](../../../../.github/workflows/ci-cd.yml) runs the api, worker, and web tests (with
E2E and the Cloudflare build) on every PR; a push to `main` deploys only after all of them pass.
There is no linter yet.

## Testing & Verification

- **Backend:** pytest.
- **Render smoke test:** renders a short MP4 from images generated by Pillow and checks it with
  `ffprobe` and extracted frames. This is the guard against silent pipeline breakage. Tests live
  in [worker/tests/](../../../../worker/tests/) and run with `pytest` from `worker/`. Tests that
  need FFmpeg are skipped, with a reason, when `ffmpeg`/`ffprobe` are not on PATH. Run them with
  FFmpeg present before merging render changes.
- **Sample render:** [samples/xuong-khop.json](../../../../samples/xuong-khop.json) and its
  committed images render end to end with the CLI.
- **Frontend:** tests cover the main flows only.
- **Visual template check:** a person watches a rendered MP4 against the template in
  [ux-guidelines.md](ux-guidelines.md#video-template). An agent cannot judge the visual result.

## Business Rules

Content rules (approved food bank rows only, non-blocking banned-word warning) are owned by
[content.md](content.md). Render concurrency and retention are owned by
[deployment.md](deployment.md).
